text: Gomɗii Men ɓannginii e ndee Alqur'aanaare ñaawooje ɗen e waajuuji ɗin e mise=yeruuji ɗen, fii yo yimɓe ɓen waajitor, ɓe jokka ko nafata ɓe, ɓe ɗala ko lorrata ɓe, ko woni fiyaake on pellet, yoga e maɓɓe no jeyaa e ɓen ɓe njikkuuji mun junnitii, ko sabu ɗum, ɓe ɓeydutaako si wonaa woɗɗitagol Goonga kan e añugol ka.
